Right drag / Q, E: rotate
Wheel / trackpad: zoom · WASD: pan
Left click: inspect a hex
inspector.hint: Select a hex to inspect source terrain and features.
urban.heading: Urban cell editor
urban.hint: River cells retain their river identity; urban buildings use dry ground. Source settlements are retained after removal.
project.heading: Project
project.hint: Self-contained JSON includes source data, height settings and urban edits.

welcome.heading: Choose your theater

credits.heading: Data sources & credits
credits.hint: Rivers retain logical cell identity; visible channels follow GIS paths with symbolic width. Urban cells use building clusters. Elevations come from Copernicus surface data; land cover is the 2021 snapshot.
